row: OMG National is a full service marketing firm established in South Florida since 1990. We have produced hundreds of corporate videos during our 20 year run, and aim to produce hundreds more in the future. We produce on digital equipment using Final Cut editing software. Our in-house digital studio adds the soundtrack for an enhanced multi-media feel. With specialties in real estate, automotive, medical, and government you can be sure that your project will be handled by the best. OMG National has the ability to create innovative corporate, trade-show, real estate, and product based videos for use on TV, the web and more!
